{
  "dataset_name": "letter",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "box_area",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates the total area of the bounding box.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 225.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a scale-dependent measure of the character's overall size, which can help the linear SVM separate characters that naturally occupy different areas.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`width` * `high`"
    },
    {
      "name": "pixel_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures the density of 'on' pixels within the bounding box.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "density_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the pixel count by the bounding box area, creating a density metric that helps the SVM distinguish between dense and sparse characters regardless of scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`onpix` / (`width` * `high` + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "aspect_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates the ratio of width to height of the bounding box.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the fundamental shape proportion of the character, providing a strong linear feature for separating wide characters from narrow ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`width` / (`high` + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "x_y_bar_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Computes the difference between the mean x and y spatial moments.",
      "value_range": [-15.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "spatial_difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights the relative shift in the center of gravity, offering a direct linear projection that contrasts horizontal versus vertical weight distribution.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`x-bar` - `y-bar`"
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates the ratio of horizontal to vertical edges.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous measure of edge orientation dominance, useful for the SVM to separate characters with predominantly vertical strokes from those with horizontal strokes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`x-ege` / (`y-ege` + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "box_perimeter",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Estimates the perimeter of the bounding box.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers an alternative scale metric to area, which scales linearly with dimensions and can provide a smoother margin for size-based separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "2.0 * (`width` + `high`)"
    },
    {
      "name": "center_of_gravity_dist",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates the Euclidean distance of the center of gravity from the center of the 15x15 grid.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "spatial_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures how off-center the character's pixel mass is, providing a non-linear spatial feature transformed into a continuous distance metric suitable for linear boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((`x-bar` - 7.5)**2 + (`y-bar` - 7.5)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "variance_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sums the variances of x and y spatial moments.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "spatial_variance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Represents the overall spread or dispersion of pixels, helping the model distinguish between compact and widely distributed character shapes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`x2bar` + `y2bar`"
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_correlation_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Computes the difference between the correlation of x-edges with y and y-edges with x.",
      "value_range": [-14.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the asymmetry in edge distributions, providing a signed linear feature that contrasts different types of diagonal or curved strokes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`xegvy` - `yegvx`"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_onpix",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalizes the total number of 'on' pixels to a 0-1 scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smoothly scaled feature of pixel count, preventing larger raw values from dominating the SVM margin calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "`onpix` / 15.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_tall_and_narrow",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses whether the bounding box proportions strongly suggest a tall and narrow shape, typical of certain characters.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a semantic, non-linear interpretation of shape proportions that might be missed by simple linear ratios, adding a distinct decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "pixel_distribution_symmetry",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Evaluates the overall symmetry of the pixel distribution based on the balance of spatial moments and edge counts.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_symmetry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures complex, multi-variable symmetry patterns into a single continuous score, allowing the linear SVM to easily separate symmetric from asymmetric characters.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
